job.question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
job.acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.

reviews.reason: This is CCCERA’s 2018 master custodian RFP, not the BCERS alternatives consultant RFP. Its ten-year custody-services qualification does not support the requested firm-in-business threshold.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR MASTER CUSTODIAN AND RELATED SERVICES April 2018 Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association
The Proposer must have been providing custody services for a minimum of ten (10) years.
